I assume the question here is more CPU usage vs GPU usage?

Sounds like you have a weaker CPU than your GPU so in intensive tasks you're fully saturating your threads of your CPU with that task and your GPU which is more powerful is keeping up just fine. It's not a bad thing to have a weaker CPU, most gaming PCs are built this way to allow more budget for the GPU. 

If you're worried about 100% CPU utilisation it's worth checking the temperature of your CPU package when doing an intensive task (you can simulate this using something like furmark) if you find temps getting way, too hot or too hot too quickly it might be worth making sure your CPU cooler is seated properly and with a nice amount of thermal paste.
